demo.title: agent-town.sh
demo.code:
# Run 1,000 individual agents through 30 days
bankr prompt "Start Agent Town: What happens if our city makes buses free?"

# Choose the population and duration
bankr prompt "Start Agent Town: Will XYZ crypto project succeed? with 2500 agents for 45 days"

setup: Ask: `Start Agent Town: <your question>` — defaults to 1,000 simulated agents and 30 days
Optional: add `with 2500 agents for 45 days` to choose the scale
Requires Bankr's code sandbox for a verified multi-agent run; no wallet transaction is needed
